gloss: limit amount, credit limit, maximum amount

definitions.gloss: limit amount, credit limit, maximum amount
definitions.explanation: The maximum monetary amount allowed for a transaction, loan, credit card, tax deduction, or other financial matter. Common in banking, insurance, and tax contexts.

examples.japanese: カードの{限度額|げんどがく}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the credit limit on my card.

examples.japanese: {控除|こうじょ}の{限度額|げんどがく}は{年間|ねんかん}200{万円|まんえん}です。
examples.english: The maximum deduction amount is two million yen per year.

examples.japanese: {融資|ゆうし}の{限度額|げんどがく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げてもらえるか、{銀行|ぎんこう}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted the bank about whether the loan limit could be raised.

notes:
A compound of {限度|げんど} (limit) + {額|がく} (amount). Very common in financial and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限度額|げんどがく}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the limit
- {限度額|げんどがく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise the limit
- {限度額|げんどがく}を{設定|せってい}する: to set a limit
- {控除|こうじょ}{限度額|げんどがく}: deduction limit
- {融資|ゆうし}{限度額|げんどがく}: loan limit
- {利用|りよう}{限度額|げんどがく}: usage limit (credit cards)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上限額|じょうげんがく}: upper limit amount — synonymous, slightly more general
- {限度|げんど}: limit — the base word without the monetary nuance; can refer to any kind of limit
- {枠|わく}: frame, quota — colloquial for credit limit or allocation (e.g., カードの{枠|わく})
